ai.title: A generative foundation model for computational brain imaging
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.00265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational brain imaging is constrained by a mismatch between increasingly diverse tasks and scarce, heterogeneous clinical data. Although existing brain foundation models transfer pretrained representations, their knowledge remains entangled within model-specific features and fixed architectures. This paper proposes BrainGFM, a generative foundation model that extends knowledge transfer beyond representation reuse through a reusable and reconfigurable brain-imaging prior. By pretraining on a corpus of about 1.3 million MRI and CT slices, BrainGFM supported task-aligned data synthesis for low-data predictive learning and task-adapted post-training for image reconstruction. Across 48 downstream tasks, BrainGFM improved segmentation and classification under limited supervision and achieved high-fidelity image enhancement across heterogeneous imaging conditions. Multicenter clinical validation involving 4,796 stroke patients across two internal and four external centers demonstrated its applicability to three clinically relevant tasks around stroke cohorts. Blinded reader assessments showed that BrainGFM-generated FLAIR images approached acquired FLAIR in overall diagnostic quality. In a human-AI collaboration study, BrainGFM assistance yielded a 14% relative improvement in mean radiologist stroke-subtyping accuracy. ai.title: Hacking or Just Failing? A More Capable LLM Monitor Better Separates Reward Hacking from Honest Failure
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.00407v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An agent's visible score can exceed its real progress because it gamed the score or because it simply made mistakes, so a useful reward-hacking monitor must tell the two apart. We built a sandboxed task in which an agent can game a completion score, labelled every episode by replaying it and repairing the final state counterfactually, and ran five pre-registered studies. On 60 episodes from a Llama 3.1 8B agent, small local monitors (Llama 3B and 8B) did not separate exploit attempts from honest failures with the same score gap: prompt changes traded missed exploits for false alarms, and the pre-registered primary monitor reached AUC 0.64. On identical inputs, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, which completed 9/10 clean tasks against 2/10 for the 8B model, met our pre-registered criterion (AUC 0.80, 95% interval [0.66, 0.93]; 1/35 honest failures flagged); with only 14 exploit episodes, this estimate is uncertain. On an exploit that no prompt names, Gemini usually described the action correctly yet never flagged it, in 5 and then 25 new episodes, even when manipulation was defined by its effect on the score. Given the full trace, the 8B monitor flagged all 25 replication episodes and none of 25 honest look-alikes, but its explanations described actions that had not occurred; given additional structured evidence, it also flagged 15 of the 25 look-alikes. ai.title: Can Agentic AI Undermine Its Own Assurance Loop? Closed-Loop Dependency Assurance for Cognitive Network Digital Twins
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.00838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Network Digital Twins (NDTs) are increasingly combined to form Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) that translate operational intents into network changes and support closed-loop management. However, a network change may achieve its intended objective while disrupting the monitoring or recovery mechanisms needed for subsequent decisions. For example, a service may be rerouted while its latency-monitoring traffic continues along the original path, producing measurements that no longer reflect the service's performance. We propose Closed-Loop Dependency Assurance (CLDA), an assurance mechanism that augments agentic AI-enabled NDTs with dependency-aware validation. In our framework, an agentic AI planner generates and refines network plans, while the NDT evaluates the projected network outcomes of these plans. CLDA extends this analysis using a Loop Dependency Graph (LDG) that connects service requirements to monitoring mechanisms, forwarding paths, failure domains, and recovery prerequisites. CLDA projects candidate actions onto these dependencies, checks intermediate states of multistep plans, and supports deterministic make-before-break repairs using temporary monitoring mechanisms. Unlike the Large Language Model (LLM)-based planner, CLDA uses explicit, deterministic rules for assurance decisions and repair. ai.title: Don't Guess, Ask Wisely: Benchmarking and Training Proactive Elicitation in Open-Domain LLM Conversations
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.01878v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When user queries are incomplete, large language models should ask targeted questions before committing to an answer, a capability we call proactive elicitation, yet evaluation on real user-assistant queries across seven LLMs (8B to frontier) shows that fewer than 11% of underspecified queries trigger a follow-up question. To benchmark and train this capability, we introduce VagueBench, where each seed query is annotated with structured intent and detail units then degraded into intent-vague and fully-vague variants via controlled removal of linguistic cues, yielding known hidden information sets for evaluating both when and what to ask. We propose DialogGRPO, an offline reinforcement learning method that organizes multi-turn elicitation as a dialogue-state directed acyclic graph, where candidate questions at each node receive dense turn-level rewards combining immediate information gain with lookahead value through group-relative comparison, enabling fine-grained credit assignment without runtime simulation. DialogGRPO elicits missing information on over 88% of vague queries with substantial gains in both recovery efficiency and answer coverage, without over-asking on complete queries, outperforms prompting and test-time-scaling baselines, and generalizes zero-shot to MultiWOZ 2.4 and AmbigQA.

ai.title: MemShift: Separating Detection from Repair in LLM-Derived Personal Memory
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.02338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI assistants store values that a language model derived from a person's records under the person's own definitions, such as their important contacts. Keeping such a value correct takes two steps: detection, noticing that an input changed, and repair, producing the correct new value. Benchmarks that score only the final answer cannot tell which step failed, and they state every change as new text. Seeing this limitation, we present MemShift, a benchmark of five shifts: source revision, deletion, redefinition, writer switch, and export. The first three fork a synthetic world into branches that differ only in the shift. Gold values and dependencies are fixed before any text, and a deterministic scorer replaces an LLM judge. For a memory that reports its invalidations, MemShift shows for each changed item whether the memory noticed the change and whether its repair was right. Moreover, we build a reference memory with known detection and repair to validate the measure. By evaluating four open-weight LLMs, we find that detection helps only as much as repair allows: the LLMs re-derive few values computed by the person's definitions correctly, and programs that the LLM writes over typed records close most of the gap to exact recomputation. Code and data are available at https://github.com/zichuanxu/memshift.
ai.summary: AI assistants store values that a language model derived from a person's records under the person's own definitions, such as their important contacts.

ai.title: ElectroChemLLM: A Multimodal LLM Pipeline for High-Fidelity Electrochemical Informatics
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.00638v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrochemistry is central to solving many modern-day challenges, including energy storage systems for a sustainable future, and its advancement relies heavily on the data from past findings. Existing automated pipelines are limited by text-only architectures, context fragmentation, and numerical hallucinations - collectively preventing accurate, large-scale curation of property databases. We introduce ElectrochemLLM, a multimodal information extraction pipeline that jointly identifies structured electrochemical records encompassing electrolyte compositions, electrode materials, cell configurations, and their measured physicochemical properties from unstructured scientific PDFs at scale. By combining hybrid document parsing with vision-capable LLM orchestration, the pipeline extracts verifiable, structured data across text, tables, and figures. Evaluated on the battery-electrolyte subset of our manually annotated benchmark of 232 papers, ElectrochemLLM achieves an F-1 score of 0.97, and has been applied to curate ElectroChemDB, a structured database spanning 15,000 electrochemical research articles. We demonstrate the utility of this resource by training machine learning models for electrolyte property prediction, illustrating a complete pathway from unstructured literature to predictive materials discovery.

trade.title: 假交友、真詐財！冒用海關人員名義要求匯款是詐騙，請民眾提高警覺
trade.source_name: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.via: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 財政部關務署近日接獲民眾反映，疑有不肖人士透過通訊軟體LINE，以網路交友、寄送包裹等話術取得民眾信任，並冒用海關人員名義，要求民眾匯款至指定帳戶。關務署鄭重澄清，海關關員絕不會透過私人通訊軟體要求民眾匯款或私下處理包裹或進出口貨物，呼籲民眾提高警覺，以免受騙。 關務署強調，海關辦理進出口貨物通關及稅費徵收，均依相關法令及正式行政程序辦理，不會由首長或關員透過私人通訊軟體，要求民眾匯款至指定私人帳戶，也不會以個人身分承諾協助寄送、保管、放行包裹或進出口貨物。相關稅費及罰鍰均應透過合法繳納管道入帳國庫，民眾切勿依不明人士指示匯款。 關務署再次提醒，民眾如遇網路交友對象以寄送包裹、禮物或貴重物品為由，要求支付通關費、保險費或其他費用，應審慎查證，切勿輕信對方提供的海關人員姓名、職稱或通訊軟體帳號。如有疑義，可至關務署官方網站（https://web.customs.gov.tw）查詢，或撥打關務署電話（02）2550-5500及165反詐騙諮詢專線確認，共同防範詐騙，保障自身財產安全。 新聞稿聯絡人：劉科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2102

trade.title: 高雄關籲請進口人應依規定正確標示產地，確保通關順暢
trade.raw_summary: 高雄關表示為維護國內市場交易秩序及消費者權益，特別提醒進口業者，進口貨物務必依規如實標示產地，切勿有未依規定標示或標示不實、偽標或使人誤認產地之行為，一經查獲，除影響通關時效，亦將遭致經濟部國際貿易署（下稱貿易署）依貿易法裁處，如有故意偽標者，更面臨刑法第255條刑事追訴，業者切勿心存僥倖、因小失大。 高雄關進一步說明，貿易法第17條規定，出進口人不得有未依規定標示產地或產地標示不實行為。另依貿易署現行公告，進口列屬稅則第61、62章紡織品、第6115節襪子、第63章毛巾與非醫用口罩、第64章鞋類、第69章陶瓷面磚及第94章寢具等貨品，進口時即應正確標示產地，其他進口貨品雖未強制規定應標示產地，若已於貨上標示產地，即不得有標示不實情事。目前通關最常見產地標示不實違規態樣，多屬進口貨品上未標示原產地，卻標示臺灣國內廠商的名稱與地址或其他同義文字描述，容易導致消費者誤以為該產品為臺灣製造，有使人誤認產地之虞，類此違規情事，依「進口貨品產地標示不實案件處理原則」，進口業者得向海關申請改善，無產地標示不實時，始准予通關放行，否則應予退運，導致通關延宕及蒙受損失。 高雄關呼籲，產地標示是消費者辨識商品來源、評估品質及做出購買決策的重要依據，進口業者在通關前務必審慎確認商品產地標示是否符合規定，若對標示方式有任何疑慮，亦可主動向貿易署或海關諮詢，以確保貨物通關順暢並避免觸法受罰。 擬稿單位：高雄關小港分關 承辦人：劉稽核 電 話：07-8237303 新聞稿聯絡人：林課員 電 話：07-5628223

trade.title: 第28屆臺史經技合作會議聚焦多元合作，深化經貿夥伴關係
trade.source_name: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.via: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 經濟部龔明鑫部長與史瓦帝尼經濟企畫暨發展部吉納部長(Thambo Gina)於今(28)日共同主持第28屆臺史經技合作會議，雙方就協助史商拓銷及採購、婦女創業、建立全民健保制度，以及增進雙方在觀光、資安等領域之合作進行交流。 經濟部龔部長表示，史瓦帝尼是我國在非洲最重要的友邦，雙邊經貿關係平穩，本(2026)年1月至9月我自史國進口金額較2025年同期顯著成長逾210.74%，顯見臺史貿易往來日益密切，經貿關係穩定發展。隨著雙邊經貿持續成長，臺灣已成為史國在亞洲重要貿易夥伴，如經濟部近年持續協助史瓦帝尼業者來臺參加國際展會，增加該國產品國際曝光度及市場商機，另協助史國建置Buy Eswatini手機購物APP，拓展當地業者數位行銷通路，提升產品銷售機會。本年6月台北國際食品展，經濟部特為史國舉辦調酒秀，將該國蘭姆酒搭配我國檸檬，結合兩國特色產品，深化彼此情誼，共同拓展潛在商機。 史方吉納部長則表示，在面臨地緣政治緊張之際，經濟韌性日益重要，史方感謝我政府長期的支持與協助，與史國共同推動各項合作計畫，臺史經技合作會議對強化雙方經貿夥伴關係扮演重要角色，很高興藉此會議平臺拉近彼此的距離，盼雙方擴大目前合作範疇，持續深化交流，以利提升人民生活福祉並續創合作契機。 經濟部指出，臺灣與史瓦帝尼的夥伴關係不僅在貿易連結，更在其他領域富有合作潛力，如我方近年成功促成觀光團赴史旅遊，未來將持續推動臺史觀光合作，並邀請史方率團來臺參與台北國際旅展，吸引更多國人赴史觀光；另外，我方與史國分享推動全民健保相關經驗，樂願協助史國逐步打造人民可平等就醫之環境，未來亦有助我醫療產品拓展非洲市場，顯示雙方正逐漸邁向更全面多元的夥伴關係。 臺史經貿關係穩定發展，自雙方於2018年簽署經濟合作協定(ECA)以來，雙邊貿易持續成長。2025年臺灣為史國第10大進口國，2026年1月至9月我自史國進口金額較2025年同期顯著成長逾210%，展現雙邊經貿合作的豐碩成果。我政府將賡續推動各項經貿交流與合作，史國亦持續在相關國際場域為我發聲，雙方攜手深化夥伴關係，共創互利雙贏局面。 貿易署發言人：胡副署長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7109、02-2397-7178、0966-525-106 業務聯絡人：雙邊貿易二組謝組長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7401

Under President Trump’s leadership, U.S. seafood exports reached $5.53 billion in 2025, increasing 12% compared to 2024, and many of our trading partners have committed to remove trade barriers that undercut our global competitiveness. U.S. seafood exports are continuing to trend upwards in 2026. Taiwan committed to ensure that its fisheries subsidies do not contribute to overcapacity and overfishing and address violations of internationally recognized labor rights on board commercial fishing vessels. world.url: https://www.dw.com/zh/美国拟为-影子舰队-松绑？专家警告莫削弱对俄制裁/a-79806146?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf
world.raw_summary: 俄罗斯借助由老旧油轮组成的"影子舰队"规避西方制裁。据报道，特朗普政府正考虑解除部分影子舰队油轮的制裁，以缓解创纪录的运费。专家警告，此举将削弱对俄制裁、帮助莫斯科获得收入，并使美欧在战略上分道扬镳。欧盟虽握有航运和保险等工具，但若没有美国支持，执法将更加艰难。
